title: The behavior of red foxes
content: Red foxes hunt small mammals and adapt to many habitats. This article introduces the wild red fox.

title: Vulpes vulpes
content: Vulpes vulpes is a widespread wild species. Its adaptable hunting behavior helps it thrive in changing habitats.

title: Wild fox species
content: The red fox is a resourceful wild hunter with a bushy tail and reddish coat.

title: The gray wolf pack
content: Gray wolves cooperate in family packs, communicate through howling, and hunt together.

title: Canis lupus
content: Canis lupus is a social wild predator. Family groups travel and communicate over large territories.

title: Wolves in cold climates
content: The white wolf and gray wolf survive cold weather with dense coats and coordinated pack behavior.

title: A golden retriever family dog
content: Golden retrievers are friendly domestic dogs that enjoy companionship and daily exercise.

title: Caring for your domestic dog
content: A golden retriever needs exercise, grooming and patient training to live happily with its family.

title: Brown bear behavior
content: The brown bear searches for food across a wide range of habitats. Ursus arctos is a powerful wild animal.

title: Grizzly bears
content: A grizzly is a brown bear. These bears forage widely and prepare for winter by building energy reserves.

title: Elk and their antlers
content: Elk are large deer. Their antlers and seasonal behavior make them distinctive grazing mammals.

title: Understanding deer herds
content: Elk gather in herds and graze on grasses. These deer communicate and move together through open habitats.

title: Sunflower pollination
content: Sunflowers depend on bees and other insects for pollination. Their bright flowers provide a summer food source.
